title: Solicitation
summary: SOLICITA'TION, noun 1. Earnest request; a seeking to obtain something from another with some degree of zeal and earnestness; sometimes perhaps, importunity. He obtained a grant by repeated solicitatio

inlines.v: SOLICITA'TION, noun 1. Earnest request; a seeking to obtain something from another with some degree of zeal and earnestness; sometimes perhaps, importunity. He obtained a grant by repeated solicitations. 2. Excitement; invitation; as the solicitation of the senses.
